verdict.rationale: The README documents a model picker that offers the account's model catalog. Model choice is set per chat alongside an effort level. Users can add their own OpenAI, Anthropic or other provider keys, so models can come from multiple providers. missing for 10: an explicit list of supported providers and models, confirmation that models from your own provider keys appear in the picker, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers

citations.quote: GPT 6.1 Sol and the other models in your account's catalog are available from the model picker.
Choose a model and an effort level (low, high, xhigh, max) per chat.
You can also add your own OpenAI, Anthropic or other provider keys.
